stemMd: By linear interpolation between1.0mm and2.0mm grains, what flow rate is predicted for1.5mm grains?
explanationMd: The diameter1.5mm is halfway between1.0 and2.0mm, so predicted flow is(40+70)/2=55mL/min.

distractorRationale.c: This is the difference between the neighbouring flow values, not their midpoint.
